/projects/dusk-chocolate.title: Marga Studio
/projects/dusk-chocolate.description: Independent digital design studio for products, websites and creative technology.
p: Dusk makes small-batch chocolate that was being bought as gifts and forgotten in drawers. The repositioning moved it from treat to ritual, something for the end of a day, not an occasion, with embossed boxes quiet enough to sit on a nightstand.

/projects/plump-soda.title: Marga Studio
/projects/plump-soda.description: Independent digital design studio for products, websites and creative technology.
p: Plump is a mango soda entering a shelf full of pastel cans whispering about wellness. The brief was the opposite: bubble letters that barely fit the can, a purple that argues with the fruit, and art direction loud enough to be seen from the register.
Digital design, product design & creative technology.

/projects/solene.title: Marga Studio
/projects/solene.description: Independent digital design studio for products, websites and creative technology.
p: FuNiHao spent a decade as a salon-only label, known by the hands that used it and almost no one else. Going direct meant writing the voice it never needed behind a counter, a mark that survives a phone screen, and packaging made to be opened on a bathroom shelf.
Digital design, product design & creative technology.

/projects/contrada.title: Marga Studio
/projects/contrada.description: Independent digital design studio for products, websites and creative technology.
p: Duolingo — Real-Life Conversations is a family sparkling wine that spent years dressed like a supermarket bottle. The new label borrows from the family's old paper archives, and the campaign photographs the wine the way it's actually drunk, mid-pour, mid-conversation, slightly too late in the evening.
Digital design, product design & creative technology.

/projects/ostro-coffee.title: Marga Studio
/projects/ostro-coffee.description: Independent digital design studio for products, websites and creative technology.
p: Ostro is a seafront coffee bar named after a southern wind, where most cups leave the counter in pairs. The identity leans into that habit, a wave-marked cup, a two-cup carrier, and a wordmark made to be read in passing, not studied.
Digital design, product design & creative technology.

/projects/ovenbird-bakery.title: Marga Studio
/projects/ovenbird-bakery.description: Independent digital design studio for products, websites and creative technology.
p: Ovenbird is a neighborhood patisserie that outgrew its handwritten labels. The identity is built around a single repeating pattern, boxes, bags, ribbon, the window, so the shop reads from across the street. A badge mark and art direction for everything the counter touches.

h2: I’m Marga Studio, a brand designer based in Brooklyn. I design strategic brand identities that help ambitious businesses earn instant trust and attract better clients.
p: I design strategic brand identities that help ambitious businesses earn instant trust and attract the clients they actually want.

I don’t start with the logo. I start with what the business is trying to become, because a mark that looks good and means nothing falls apart under the first question. The design comes easily once we know what we’re designing for.

Outside of work I run early, before the city starts. I watch a film most nights, usually alone, usually one I’ve already seen. And I take the long way home when it goes past a building I like, which is most of the time.
Digital design, product design & creative technology.
